content.title: The Masked Singer spoilers: Who is Pugcasso?
content.text: Warning: this item includes The Masked Singer spoilers for Season 14 — read at your own risk! Pugcasso made his debut on the Jan. 7 premiere of The Masked Singer Season 14 and immediately had us spiraling. After a soulful rendition of “Ordinary,” we went back and forth — first wondering about Anthony Ramos, then convincing ourselves it might be Glee alum Chord Overstreet. However, after this week’s clues, we’re finally ready to plant our flag. We believe Pugcasso is none other than American Idol Season 11 winner Phillip Phillips. In hindsight, the home plate clue from Week 1 was never about baseball; it was a clever nod to “Home,” his massive American Idol coronation single that later became an unofficial anthem of the 2012 London Olympics. The real smoking gun arrived this week with the reference to “the biggest show of my life” in another country, where he stood between Bruce Springsteen and John Mayer in front of 100,000 people. That matches Phillips’ 2013 Rock in Rio set exactly — caught ya! The evidence only gets stronger with the “132 million” visual, a clear reference to the record-breaking number of votes cast during his American Idol victory over Jessica Sanchez. Add in the Georgia roots and that raspy folk-pop tone, and the clues are officially airtight. Pugcasso may be wearing a mask, but the voice belongs to Phillip Phillips. Gold Derby’s guess: Phillip PhillipsPhillip PhillipsPhoto : Kelly Sullivan/Getty Images for ONEHOPE Phillip Phillips is a Georgia-born singer-songwriter who went from working in his family’s pawn shop to becoming a household name after winning Season 11 of American Idol in 2012. He’s best known for his massive hit "Home," which became an anthem for the 2012 London Olympics. With a soulful, raspy voice and a guitar-heavy style that leans into folk and rock, he’s carved out a steady career touring with legends like John Mayer and releasing four studio albums, most recently Drift Back in 2023. Pugcasso Performance 1: “Ordinary”Pugcasso on The Masked SingerPhoto : Michael Becker/Fox Audio Clue: "Well hello there my furry friends. I'm Pugcasso, and welcome to the joy of panting. Today, we're going to paint a happy little career change. See, I was supposed to take over the family business, but sometimes you've got to color outside the lines — like the time I threw my name in the hat on something big and my life changed overnight. I joined an ensemble of dreamers just like me — and before you know it, I went from nobody to top dog. Something only a handful of artists have achieved. Just like that, we painted success. But as for me, I'm still that ordinary pup living in an extraordinary world." Visual Clues: A door sign that said "All Star," a painting of home plate (baseball), the Big Ben clock, Pugcasso winning a first-place trophy, and a theater marquee that reads "Pugcasso Studio Live!" What made you say 'yes' to The Masked Singer? "I'm a pretty private person. I've never worn a costume like this ever before in my life. This is something new!" Panelist Guesses: Dan Reynolds of Imagine Dragons (Ken), Darren Criss (Rita), and Ryan Tedder of OneRepublic (Robin). Pugcasso Performance 2: “Fake Plastic Trees”Pugcasso on "Clueless Night" of 'The Masked Singer' Photo : Michael Becker/Fox Audio Clue: "Coming from a small town, I thought I knew everybody. But then, I saw her. Instantly, my heart went [beat beat]. A few weeks later I saw her again. Life was trying to tell me something so I took my shot — and that was it. It was like a real-life romcom. We were so in love, until I was asked to hit the road and — worst of all — to move a world away from my girl. Fast-forward to when I got to the airport and there she was — with a suitcase in hand. Ever since then, when fame feels superficial, she keeps me grounded." Visual Clues: Pugcasso was seen golfing, holding a sign that says “Bye Bye Bye,” and courting his lady friend with ice cream, candle light, and a spaghetti and meatballs dinner. Other clues included a matchbox he packed in his suitcase. Onstage clue: A Hawaiian shirt, to which he responded, "I like the beach and I like cameras." Panelist Guesses: Jack Johnson (Robin) and Rob Thomas (Ken) Pugcasso Performance 3: “Too Much”Pugcasso on "Spice Girl Night" of 'The Masked Singer.' Photo : Trae Patton/ FOX Audio Clue: "Spice Girls? Man, they were lucky to have each other. Call me 'Jealous Spice' because there have been many times being on my own that have felt mighty lonely, like when I was in another country doing the biggest show of my life, surrounded by legends. Bruce Springsteen to my left, John Mayer to my right — and it was my turn to go onstage in front of hundreds of thousands of people, all by myself. But, the moment I stepped on stage, the entire stadium went wild. They sang along to every single word. It turns out, I wasn't alone. I had 100,000 voices joining mine." Visual Clues: A jukebox, a dog bowl, up-and-down arrows, a sign referencing "132 million," and a moon. London clue: A letter that says "Rejected: Series Lead." He said, "Some people told me that I wasn't good at music. Luckily they weren't good at their job either, so it all worked out in the end." Panelist Guesses: Pat Monahan (Ken), Vance Joy (Jenny), and Charlie Puth (Rita). Pugcasso Performance 4: “Dreams”Pugcasso performance 4 on 'The Masked Singer' Photo : Trae Patton/ FOX Audio Clue: "Just like those Care Bears, I have all the feelings from making it this far. But Ken, I'm tried of watching you throw paint at the wall. You're the sports guy. Spoiler alert! This isn't my first competition — I've even taken the Olympics by storm. Cheer up! I'm just trying to help." Colossal Care Bears Clue: The Olympic torch. He said, "Being a part of the Olympics changed my life forever." Panelist Guesses: Gavin DeGraw (Jenny), Jason Mraz (Rita), and Pat Monahan (Ken). Pugcasso Performance 5: “Bad Dreams”Pugcasso on "Semi-Finals" episode of 'The Masked Singer' Photo : Trae Patton/ FOX Audio Clue: "America, all season you've been trying to close the case on me. Let me give you a peek into my file. Hi guys, I would love to be a part of The Masked Singer. There was a moment when everyone in America had their eyes on me. Suddenly, this hometown boy was thrown into interviews and photoshoots. The problem is, I've always thought of myself as a musician — not a celebrity. I work really hard to keep my life as normal as possible for me and my family. My own kid doesn't know I'm famous. So you can imagine, I would love to do the show. Now I feel lucky to have been chosen. The best thing is, it's been about the art. Music. That's why I want to make it to the finale — this has allowed me to do what I do best." Visual clues: A VHS audition tape dated 2012 Personal Connection Clue: Jenny McCarthy Wahlberg.In his Q&A with Jenny, we learned Pugcasso met Jenny on a stage, they never dated, they never presented an award together, and they were never on TMZ together — but she may have introduced him on a former talk show or podcast she worked on. Panelist Guesses: Shay Mooney (Jenny), Darren Criss (Rita)
